thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: org cb-77 (cobaltburst) experiencing surge -> elevated 429s and latency p95 spike. Alert: org-rate-limit breached and backpressure on routing pool-gpu-4. Dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/CB-77

oncall_sre: seeing sustained 429s from customer keys, ~15% of requests failing, queue depth on pool-gpu-4 at 120 (norm ~30).

jessica: customer ops on support line, they say multiple jobs are failing. CSM looped in.

mike: i'm on my way but have a 5m ETA. if this looks like capacity, consider emergency unthrottle for the org.

ranjit: I'm available, taking pager. timeline? any recent deploys for cobaltburst?

jessica: no deploys in last 30m. We saw a sudden traffic ramp from one API path (/v1/generate/bulk).

kate-csm: CobaltBurst confirms customer-facing timeouts. They have Reserved capacity but RL gate kicked in. Customer impact: jobs queued and some automated retries exhausted. They're asking for immediate relief.

ranjit: ok plan: 1) apply temporary org quota bump (2x) for 20m 2) disable smart-routing feature for cb-77 to reduce cross-pool coordination 3) monitor error rate and p95 for 15m then decide next steps. Executing change now.

ranjit: ```
redwoodctl org adjust-rl --org cb-77 --qps-multiplier 2.0 --duration 20m --reason "prod spike: emergency quota bump"
```

deploy-bot: change cb-rl-adjust-8642 accepted -> executed by ranjit at 1709998920. result: success.

jessica: also flipping feature flag: `ffctl toggle --org cb-77 --flag smart-routing --off --reason "reduce routing overhead during surge"`

incident-bot: metrics update: 3m after change -> 429 rate dropped from 15% -> 1.2%, p95 latency reduced ~45% to within acceptable SLO delta. CPU on pool-gpu-4 down to 72%.

mike: confirmed from dashboards, request backlog draining. Nice quick work.

kate-csm: passed note to customer: "We've applied a temporary quota increase and disabled SmartRouting for your org to reduce timeouts. We will revert the change after traffic normalizes and follow up with a postmortem." They acknowledged and say they can tolerate 20m window.

oncall_sre: recommend we schedule a controlled re-enable: canary smart-routing at 5% traffic in 1 hour, and create a permanent fallback to a smaller model variant when RL triggers.

jessica: agreed — i'll file a PR for model fallback rules and add an automated alert for RL recurrences on high-vol path.

ranjit: created incident ticket INC-2026-4598 with notes and runbook link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-4598. I'll revert the RL bump at ~170999 (20m after change) unless we extend.

deploy-bot: scheduled revert job cb-rl-adjust-8642-revert at 170999 (placeholder).

mike: thanks everyone. Post-incident: follow-up with infra to review autoscaling thresholds (pool-gpu-4) and CSM/Account team to discuss bursting policy for reserved customers. :thumbsup:

jessica: marking this thread resolved for on-call; will add notes to the postmortem draft.

ranjit: handing off monitoring to next shift. closing pager for now.

mike: thanks :raised_hands:
